caption: The drawing depicts a single, worn shoe with a high heel, viewed from an angle that shows both the side and a portion of the upper surface. The shoe appears to be an old-fashioned style, possibly made of leather, and is colored in muted, earthy tones of brown and green. There are visible cracks and weathered areas on the shoe, indicating damage and age. On the side of the shoe, the word "SHINE" is written in capital letters. A small, tattered bow or rosette is attached to the upper part near the opening. The background of the drawing is a plain, light color with no additional objects or scenery, highlighting the shoe as the main subject.
title: Shoe Shop Sign
